dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the maximum width of the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight symmetrical indentation immediately posterior to the melon/neck region, followed by smooth, continuous lateral margins without significant bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity pixel baseline across the entire dorsal plane with minimal grayscale variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal ridge visible along the central dorsal axis extending from the mid-section toward the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark, circular aperture (blowhole) located on the anterior dorsal midline.
